name: Koorihama Juri
source:
His Wish: [spoiler](From Urara's Route)
# 『永遠』 = Eternity[/spoiler]
Tool: Bonnet
# 『フラキア』= Furakia
Function:[spoiler]
# Rewinds the time of an person (except Conscience).
# This includes any object the Person is wearing or carrying.[/spoiler]
Hates the fate of time because it rots all beauty.
You can't be sure if he is on your side or not, but he stays true to a promise even if given to the greatest enemy.
[spoiler]
The bonnet is a memento of his actress mother, who lost her job due to aging, which resulted in his wish and lifestyle.[/spoiler]
